# GetCategoryList/GetAchievementCategory, which do not run headlessly, so an achievement placed
# only there lands here. What matters is the DIFF - a subtree that stops loading moves its
# achievements into this section, which is how the 19 dropped nodes of 2026-09-20 would show.
